checkedSources.purpose: WP4 evidence, storage controls, and current gate state
WORM receipts, SLS correlation, release identity, and remaining actions

decisionItems.name: Deployment runbook location
decisionItems.finding: No versioned Commit 6 deployment runbook bound to this release ID and artifact digest was found. Existing npm scripts do not expose a deploy command.

decisionItems.name: Rollback runbook location
decisionItems.finding: Existing Step 14 rollback notes cover disabling the non-default feature flag, but no Commit 6 rollback runbook with precise trigger, target, validation, and escalation path is approved for this release.

decisionItems.name: Gate Input Manifest location
decisionItems.finding: The Gate Input Manifest has a WORM OSS URI, Version ID, SHA-256 digest, readback verification, and 9/9 SLS correlation with a recorded Request ID correction.

decisionItems.name: Gate validator required in candidate repository
decisionItems.finding: No Commit 6 gate validator that consumes the Gate Input Manifest and validates the final readiness predicates was identified in the candidate repository.

decisionItems.name: SLI and parity criteria may be externally versioned
decisionItems.finding: Repository docs list categories such as availability, error rate, latency, functional parity, rendering parity, build/runtime health, and rollback health, but no immutable external criteria binding was found for this release.

decisionItems.name: Runtime evidence sufficient without repository changes
decisionItems.finding: WP4 build and test evidence is valid for the artifact, but Commit 6 runtime readiness still lacks deployment, canary, observability, rollback, and parity evidence.

decisionItems.name: Existing build/deploy/rollback platform capability verified
decisionItems.finding: Build capability is evidenced by WP4. Deploy, canary, exact digest deployment, active pointer atomicity, health monitoring, rollback, rollback receipt, and deployment audit logging are not evidenced by real receipts.

decisionItems.name: Approved baseline
decisionItems.finding: No approved baseline release ID, immutable artifact digest, and verification evidence reference was found.

decisionItems.name: Approved rollback target
decisionItems.finding: No approved rollback target release ID, immutable artifact digest, and verified recoverability evidence was found.

decisionItems.name: Approved canary scope
decisionItems.finding: No canary scope was approved with environment, cluster, traffic percentage, cohort, start condition, observation window, abort thresholds, and rollback trigger.

decisionItems.name: Safety rollback authorized
decisionItems.finding: No explicit safety rollback authorization was found for this release.

decisionItems.name: Planned rollback drill authorized
decisionItems.finding: No planned rollback drill authorization was found for this release.

decisionItems.name: Repository changes required
decisionItems.finding: A deploy/runbook/validator owner decision is required before determining the exact repository changes. At minimum, the current repository does not contain a Commit 6 gate validator or release-bound runbook reference.

decisionItems.name: Exact required changes
decisionItems.finding: Exact changes cannot be safely listed until deployment runbook, rollback target, canary scope, SLI/parity criteria, and validator ownership are approved.

decisionItems.name: Final Commit 6 readiness decision
decisionItems.finding: WP5 does not pass. Commit 6 runtime readiness remains technical-verification required; WP6, final gate, and deployment remain blocked.
